description: Eryenia Elararides wears a purple floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and gold geometric woven borders at the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, centre and hem. Round shoulder brooches, a matching patterned belt with a round medallion buckle, a pendant and hanging earrings accompany the gown. An ivory wrap with purple and gold borders and patterned corners rests around her arms. An ivory underdress and a closed brown decorated shoe show at the lower walking opening. Her swept-back gathered hair is uncovered.
